ruleset.name: PMD-Rules
ruleset.description: This ruleset is responsible for the calculation of cyclomatic complexity and other related metrics.

rule.name: CyclomaticComplexityCheck
rule.message: Cyclomatic complexity should be less than 10
rule.description: Checks that cyclomatic complexity is less than 10

rule.name: CognitiveComplexityCheck
rule.message: Cognitive complexity should be less than or equal to the number of method
rule.description: Checks that Cognitive Complexity is less than 10.

rule.name: ExcessiveImportsCheck
rule.message: Excessive Imports should be less than 30
rule.description: Checks class coupling is less than 30.

rule.name: CouplingBetweenObjectsCheck
rule.message: Coupling between objects should be less than 20
rule.description: Checks that Coupling Between Objects is less than 20.
